abstract: We report a rare case of growing teratoma syndrome(GTS). The patient was a 37-year-old man diagnosed as having a mixed germ cell tumor of the right testis. After resection of the right testis, the patient developed multiple lung metastases and chemotherapy was administered. However, in spite of the normalization of the serum AFP level, the lung metastases continued to increase in size. The lung metastases were successfully resected and pathological examination revealed the diagnosis of a mature teratoma. GTS is defined as an enlarging tumor mass during or after chemotherapy in the case of germ cell tumors, with normalization of the serum AFP. Total surgical resection of the mass yielded a good result. Recognition of this syndrome is important for successful treatment.
abstract_ja: 我々は growing teratoma syndrome の稀な症例を報告する。症例は37歳男性で、右精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。右精巣摘除後に多発性肺転移を生じ、化学療法が施行された。しかし血清AFP値が正常化したにもかかわらず、肺転移は増大を続けた。肺転移巣は外科的切除され、病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と診断された。growing teratoma syndromeは、化学療法中または化学療法後に胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘤が増大し、血清AFPは正常化する状態と定義される。腫瘤の完全な外科的切除で良好な結果が得られた。本症候群を認識することが治療の成功に重要である。
